rules.rule: Minimal mood is mandatory. White or off-white backgrounds, black or very dark text, single accent color for actions only. No decorative elements that don't serve a function.
Clear visual hierarchy: task titles 16sp medium, subtasks 14sp regular, metadata (due date, priority) 12sp muted color. Indentation for nested tasks: 16dp per level.
Quick add/capture must be a persistent floating button or large input at top. Friction to add a task must be 1 tap. Voice and text input both supported.
Task completion: checkbox left-aligned, strikethrough title on check, subtle slide-out animation. Completed tasks move to bottom with muted styling, not deleted.
Home view is Today view: date header, task count for today, overdue section (if any) highlighted in red, no-due-date inbox section at bottom.
